findings.state_artifact: C-r2/D-64-legal-allergens.png, D-65-legal-allergens-milieu.png (legal claim) vs D-27-assistant-recap.dom.html, M-32-assistant-recap.dom.html, D-28-panier-tiroir.dom.html, D-36-paiement-bouton.dom.html, D-38-confirmation-milieu.dom.html (no allergen shown)
findings.evidence: The live allergen page promises information that the ordering flow no longer shows. legal/allergens.html:73-75: 'Les allergènes spécifiques à chaque produit sont également affichés en temps réel dans les pages produit du menu en ligne (modale détail + récapitulatif du wizard de personnalisation + ticket de commande)'. legal/allergens.html:170: 'Dans le wizard de personnalisation : à chaque étape (viandes, sauces, suppléments), les allergènes des options sélectionnées sont agrégés.' legal/allergens.html:171: 'Sur le récapitulatif de commande : les allergènes totaux apparaissent avant validation finale.' Product reality: the wizard still computes the list (wizard-v2.jsx:563 'const allergensList = Array.from(allergens);') but never renders it. grep finds 1 occurrence, the declaration only. The banner and the preview box were removed on purpose (wizard-v2.jsx:839 '[OWNER 2026-07-28] Bandeau « Allergènes détectés » retiré du flux (copy anxiogène)' and :1029 'Encadré allergènes retiré de l'aperçu'). Second, independent means: the bench's Tacos L includes 'Cheddar', and Cheddar carries allergens ['lactose'] (data/menu.js:205). Yet 'lactose' appears 0 times in the DOM of the recap (D-27, M-32), the cart (D-28), payment (D-36) and confirmation (D-38). The Tacos L sheet shows only 'Gluten' (D-20 DOM: 'Gluten | Voir les infos allergènes'). A lactose-intolerant customer who trusts the legal page gets no warning anywhere in the purchase path. INCO requires allergen information before a distance purchase is concluded.
findings.fix_hint: OWNER DECISION. Either (a) render allergensList as one discreet line in the recap ('Contient : lait, gluten'), which is the cheapest way to make the legal text true, or (b) rewrite allergens.html:72-76 and :170-171 to describe what really exists: product sheet base allergens, the full table, and staff on request. Do not leave the current text.

findings.category: element_overlap (fixed bar hides the end of the page)
findings.evidence: On the mobile website payment page at maximum scroll (M-41 scrollY 2845 + 664 = document height 3509), the fixed 'Retour / Confirmer ma commande' bar covers the end of the site footer. The health notice 'Pour votre santé, pratiquez une activité physique régulière. www.mangerbouger.fr' is cut in half at the bar's top edge (its second line and link are barely legible). '© 2026 LE CAYENNE' is entirely hidden. The page cannot scroll further. Cause: styles-mobile.css:149-155 makes '.lcf-cta-bar' position:fixed and pads only '.lcf-page' (padding-bottom:120px). index.html:169-171 pads only '.lcf-card'. The footer comes after .lcf-page in the DOM (M-36 DOM: lcf-page at offset 23803, footer at 36595), so nothing reserves the bar's height under the footer. The mangerbouger line is the mandatory health notice on food promotion and its link is unreachable on this page.
findings.fix_hint: While the funnel bar is shown, pad the body (or the footer) by the bar's height, as body.lc-cartbar-on already does for the menu bar (styles-mobile.css:605), or hide the footer on the payment route.
